title: Radar Station Extract
info:
Requirement: Pull the Extraction Point Lever by the Armory middle entrance to open this for a limited time.

Travel down the Radar Station staircase in the center to the bottom. There you will find the extract.

title: Extraction Point Lever
info: Pulling this opens the Radar Station Extract or the Underground Mine Extract for a limited time (5 minutes). Check your map to see which has a timer. Triggers map alarm.

title: B1 Canal Extract
info:
Requirement: Pull the B1 Canal Extract Lever in the Control Room, F2 of the Armory.

Travel down to the basement B1 and head towards the stairs where the extract flare is. Hang around until the boat leaves. Leaves automatically in 3 minutes once lever pulled. Once-off use extract per map.

title: B1 Canal Extract Lever
info: Pulling this opens the B1 Canal Extract for a limited time (3 minutes before it leaves).

title: Underground Mine Extract
info:
Requirement: Pull the Extraction Point Lever by the Armory middle entrance to open this for a limited time (5 minutes).

As you travel North you will eventually see the flare. This is a long run from the lever.

title: Eastern Blockade Extract
info: Either this extract is open, or Western Blockade Extract is. If this is open, you can extract here without a backpack equipped.

title: Western Blockade Extract
info: Either this extract is open, or Eastern Blockade Extract is. If this is open, you can extract here without a backpack equipped.

title: Inspection Area Guard Room Entrance Lever
info: Pulling this opens the middle Armory door to the right of the open area just outside of this room (The middle entrance). 1m 40s for door to unlock. Triggers map alarm.

title: Garage Entrance Lever
info: Pulling this opens the Garage entrance to the Armory, right next to this lever (The left entrance). 1m (60s) for door to unlock. Triggers map alarm.

title: Office Area Maintainance Room Lever
info: Pulling this opens the Office Area Maintainance entrance to the Armory, just to the South of this lever (The right entrance). 1m 40s for door to unlock. Triggers map alarm.
